# Accessibility Requirements Quality Checklist: The portfolio

**Purpose**: Validate that WCAG 2.2 AA requirements for the portfolio are complete, clear, consistent and measurable (reviewer, PR and pre-implementation).
**Created**: 2026-09-29
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist`. Items test the quality of the written requirements, not the implementation.

## Reduced Motion

- [ ] CHK001 Is "reduced motion is requested" defined as one signal, and is it applied identically to the progress bar, heading uncover, sticky visuals, page transitions and clips? [Consistency, Spec §FR-060]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the "final state" of a chapter under reduced motion described precisely enough to be judged objectively (visible, unhidden, unpinned)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-060]
- [ ] CHK003 Are requirements defined for a reader who changes the reduced-motion setting while a page is open? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK004 Are motion requirements defined for the option comparison and theme filter (not only the story page effects)? [Completeness, Gap]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the reduced-motion capture requirement for visual baselines consistent with the reduced-motion behaviour it relies on? [Consistency, Spec §FR-084]

## JavaScript-off Reading

- [ ] CHK006 Is the complete list of what must be readable without JavaScript enumerated for stories and for the index? [Completeness, Spec §FR-061]
- [ ] CHK007 Do the no-JavaScript requirements for the filter (controls hidden, all projects listed) agree with the filter's own requirements? [Consistency, Spec §FR-062, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK008 Is it specified that content hidden by script-driven effects (uncover, sticky) is visible before script runs, to avoid a flash of missing content? [Gap, Spec §FR-025]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the boundary between "script for interactive pieces" and "script for effects" unambiguous? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-064]

## Option Comparison Island

- [ ] CHK010 Are the table semantics (row and column headers, scope, caption) specified to a level a checker can verify? [Measurability, Spec §FR-032]
- [ ] CHK011 Are the name and focus-order requirements for the scrollable region defined, including how it is announced? [Clarity, Spec §FR-032]
- [ ] CHK012 Are "meets", "partly meets" and "does not meet" required to be distinguishable without colour or icon alone? [Completeness, Spec §FR-030]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the chosen option's marking required in text and independent of colour, and is contrast specified for it in both themes? [Coverage, Spec §FR-031, Spec §FR-083]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the enhancement's keyboard interaction model defined, or explicitly stated as absent? [Gap, Spec §FR-033]
- [ ] CHK015 Are requirements defined for the optional "In its favour" and "Against it" rows appearing or not appearing, in terms of reading order and header association? [Clarity, Spec §FR-030]
- [ ] CHK016 Is behaviour specified for a comparison with very many options or constraints at 320 px width? [Edge Case, Spec §SC-008]

## Theme Filter Island

- [ ] CHK017 Is the filter control's type (buttons, radio group, links) and the group name and pressed/selected state exposed to assistive technology specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the announcement of the shown count specified (wording, politeness, timing) including the zero-result case? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK019 Is focus management defined when the filter changes, is cleared, or hides the focused item? [Gap, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the `?theme=` state's relation to back/forward navigation and to unknown theme values specified? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK021 Are target size (WCAG 2.5.8) and visible focus (2.4.11) requirements stated for filter controls and pills? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK022 Do the pill requirements state that theme and status meaning is not conveyed by colour alone? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017]

## Chapter List Landmark

- [ ] CHK023 Is the "In this story" list's landmark role, accessible name and position in reading order defined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-027]
- [ ] CHK024 Is it specified how the list identifies the current chapter, without relying on motion or colour alone? [Gap, Spec §FR-027]
- [ ] CHK025 Is the relationship between the list's links and chapter heading anchors (focus destination, scroll offset under sticky elements) defined? [Gap, Spec §FR-027]
- [ ] CHK026 Are heading-level requirements for the title, chapters and building blocks specified so the outline has no skipped levels? [Completeness, Spec §FR-021]

## Progress Indicator

- [ ] CHK027 Is it stated whether the progress bar is exposed to assistive technology or hidden from it, with the reason? [Clarity, Spec §FR-024]
- [ ] CHK028 Is the progress bar's behaviour without JavaScript and without scroll-linked effect support defined? [Coverage, Spec §FR-024, Spec §FR-063]
- [ ] CHK029 Are contrast requirements for the bar defined in both themes (non-text contrast, 1.4.11)? [Gap, Spec §FR-083]

## Page Transitions

- [ ] CHK030 Is the transition's effect on focus placement and on the announced page title after navigation specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-026]
- [ ] CHK031 Is the element the transition "carries" defined precisely enough to be objectively judged? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-026]
- [ ] CHK032 Is the fallback for interrupted or unsupported transitions consistent with the normal-page-load requirement? [Consistency, Spec §FR-063]

## Visuals, Demos and Layout

- [ ] CHK033 Are text-alternative requirements consistent across index visuals, chapter visuals, diagrams and clips? [Consistency, Spec §FR-071, Spec §FR-044]
- [ ] CHK034 Are the accessible-name, title and keyboard-trap requirements for embedded demo frames defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-041]
- [ ] CHK035 Are sticky-visual requirements defined for zoom to 400 percent and text spacing overrides (reflow 1.4.10, 1.4.12)? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §SC-008]
- [ ] CHK036 Is the wide-screen sticky layout's reading and focus order relative to the chapter text specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-023]
- [ ] CHK037 Are both themes and both widths named as the scope of the automated accessibility checks, and is "every story" defined? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003, Spec §FR-083]
- [ ] CHK038 Is the "Draft" and "not a live demo" labelling required to be available as text to assistive technology? [Completeness, Spec §FR-043, Spec §FR-074]
